description: This file is a shell script that provides utility functions for managing prebuilt tools in a build environment. Its main functions include refreshing timestamps of build directories, extracting prebuilt tools from tar archives, and installing tools.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps of files in the specified directory, excluding symbolic links.

methods.name: extract_prebuilt_tar
methods.description: Extracts prebuilt tools from a tar archive.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps for build directories and validates their existence.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Installs prebuilt tools from a tar archive and refreshes build directory timestamps.
